digest.component_or_area: close disposition and precheck command logic
propositions: Three near-identical walkers discover a ticket's replacement link by iterating deps for duplicates then calling find_inbound_relationships for supersedes, differing only in liveness check and return type

The three walkers must be consolidated into one shared core function replacement_of(ticket_id, tracker, *, require_live, on_subject_unreadable) that performs both the outbound duplicates scan and the inbound supersedes scan, with class and ticket_type filtering remaining at each wrapper

A construct-uniqueness guard must scan src/rebar excluding close_disposition.py and reject any file containing both find_inbound_relationships( and "supersedes" unless marked with a reasoned # replacement-walk-ok: escape comment
_NON_COMPLETION_BUG_CLASSES must be defined as an alias to close_disposition.DISPOSITION_CLASSES (the same object, not merely equal) so the two cannot drift
The three monkeypatch seams _has_live_replacement_link, _recorded_replacement_target, and find_replacement must retain their exact names and signatures for test compatibility
The non-bug ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES narrowing that only _has_live_replacement_link applies must be preserved, refusing a duplicate close when ticket_type is not in ADMINISTRATIVE_CLASSES
